spans.s:
√laṣ 'desire'
present: [1.] laṣati laṣate etc. E.+ -- [4.] laṣyati laṣyate 
perfect: lalāṣa leṣus leṣe 
[aorist: alīlaṣat alaṣīt alāṣīt alaṣiṣṭa ]
future: [1.] laṣiṣyati laṣiṣyate -- [2.] laṣitā 
verbal: laṣitá E.+ 
[secondary: lālaṣ- lilaṣiṣa- lāṣaya- ]
derivatives: -laṣya -laṣaṇīya C. -lāṣa C. -lāṣaka E.+ -lāṣin C. -lāṣuka C. 
Hardly occurs, in verb-forms or derivatives, except with abhi.

√las 'be lively'
present: [1.] lasati etc. E.+ lasate etc. 
perfect: lalāsa 
[aorist: alīlasat alasīt lasiṣyati lasitā ]
verbal: lasita E.+ 
secondary: causative: lāsayati etc. E.+ lāsyate 
derivatives: -las -lasa B.+ -lasana C. lāsana E.+ lāsa E.+ lāsaka E.+ -lāsin E.+ lāsya E.+ lālasa E.+ 
In meaning, lālasa belongs distinctly to √laṣ, and the two roots are very possibly one in origin; alasa is the only pre-epic form.
